items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally. Evidence: the security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. Recommendation: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; allow only bounded reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim certification, clean health, exploit results, or credential exposure findings.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, incident response readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
